name: ElectricBorder-TS-TW
title: Electric Border
description: A content card outlined by a glowing turquoise frame, with a second loose ring of lightning-like lines that shifts and flickers around it.
use: A featured card or hero panel needs to feel live and high-energy without a video.
avoid: Its outline spills far outside the card and the loop never rests, so it fights tight layouts and busy pages.
a11y: Pure decoration with nothing to operate, but the endless flashing outline ignores reduced-motion preferences. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card holding a small pill label, a bold white heading and grey body text. Two turquoise outlines wrap it: a smooth blurred glow hugging the edge, and a ragged ring of thin lines that wanders away from the card.
behaves: The ragged ring keeps redrawing, its peaks surging and drifting around the edge like static electricity at a pace set by speed, while the card and its smooth glow stay still.
customise: Colour, animation speed, noise amount and corner radius are props, with className and style for the wrapper. The glow layers and noise sampling are fixed in the source.
weight: moderate: A ten-octave noise canvas redraws every frame and several blurred layers sit behind it.
demo: Badge "Featured" above the heading "Electric Border" and a short paragraph about the outline.
issues: The jagged outline spills well outside the card and can overlap nearby content.
The crackle never settles, so several of these on one page would compete for attention.
polishWhy: Distinctive glow with a believable crackle; the wandering outline is a little untidy at the corners.
